name: Accounts Payable: Bill & Invoice Request Email Format
trigger: Someone needs Accounts Payable to generate a bill or an invoice.
purpose: Ensures every bill and invoice request sent to A/P is entered correctly and nothing is lost or missed. Any email to ap@getthom.com requesting a bill or invoice must carry the matching data block in the body.
doneWhen: A/P has entered the bill or invoice from a complete, correctly formatted request.

steps.title: Bill or invoice?
steps.trigger: A bill or invoice needs to be generated.
steps.work: Decide which block applies. A bill is owed to a Network Operator; an invoice is issued to a Brand. If both are needed in one email, use separate blocks; never combine them.
rules: Do not combine bill and invoice in the same block.

steps.title: Fill in the Bill block
steps.trigger: The request is for a bill.
steps.work: Copy the Bill block and fill every field: NO (bill number if applicable), Service Period, Bill Date (use the date on the source document), Description, Project (name or code, e.g. Brand and city for robots), Amount (if quantity × rate, specify both). Write N/A rather than leaving a field blank.
rules: Fill in every field; write N/A if not applicable.

steps.title: Fill in the Invoice block
steps.trigger: The request is for an invoice.
steps.work: Copy the Invoice block and fill every field: Brand Name (the brand the invoice is issued under), Service Period, Invoice Date, Line Description, Project, Amount (if quantity × rate, specify both), Memo (optional). Write N/A rather than leaving a field blank.
rules: Fill in every field; write N/A if not applicable.

steps.title: Double-check the amount
steps.work: Re-check the amount before sending, including the quantity × rate breakdown when applicable (e.g. 10 hrs × $50/hr = $500).

steps.title: Email the request to A/P
steps.work: Send the email to ap@getthom.com with the completed block(s) in the body. Never send an A/P request without the block.
rules: Do not send an A/P email without the block.

steps.title: A/P checks the request is complete
steps.trigger: A request email arrives at ap@.
steps.work: A/P checks that the block is present and every field is filled. Incomplete requests are returned to the requester.

steps.title: A/P generates the bill or invoice
steps.work: A/P enters the bill or invoice in the accounting system from the block, charging it to the stated project.
